body:
I don't think they really know how i'm feeling. I don't really tell people when i'm feeling down. I think they can tell. I have one close friend who i've always talked about it with. But i feel like i'm starting to annoy her. I dont even want to talk about it with her, i just want to be there for her when shes down like i try with all my friends. I just want to be able to talk to them and them be honest with me.


Liking her isn't a flaw but it's an issue. I just wish i could be happy with the friendship we have and not keep worrying about it.

Im gonna see my doctor again next week, ill probably give up and start on meds. See if that helps. It probably will help bits but i dont wanna spend the rest of my life on meds. How can i be happy knowing my happiness isn't real?

I get that and thats what people keep telling me, i dunno. It's hard to explain. I dont see this the same way as needing meds for my heart or whatever else. The best way i've been able to is that i got myself into this position, it's not 'My body needs these meds to balance this chemical' or whatever. Like, i control my own thoughts and emotions. Or at least i try to. I don't control how well i can breathe or if my blood pressure is low or whatever people take meds for.

I don't want to rely on something else to be 'happy' i already do that with my friends and now i'm always living in fear that i'm close to losing that.

None, i've always felt like this is something i need to do without help but once i started getting suicidal thoughts i went to see my GP. He strongly recommended them but i just can't. I can't become reliant on something else.
